text: {"score":4,"justification":"The summary is accurate and grounded. Numbers match the card: 20.6% of 238 claims billed as 99215 vs 5.0% expected, risk-adjusted score 5.30, z 3.04, 20% of 99215s in low-complexity patients, 18 documented claims, 3 of 3 documented 99215s below billed, 2 of 13 data-reviewed notes with no lab line. The language is cautious (\"a reason to review the records, not a finding\"). Cited claims fit their sentences: C0043022 and C0043068 are documented moderate, C0043095 is documented moderate with 4 conditions, and the three low-complexity 99215s match the card. Next steps are concrete. Weaknesses: the headline says 4 of 14 (29%), which the summary body never explains. The card shows 1 below billed for 99214 plus 3 for 99215, so 4 is derivable, but 14 is the 11 + 3 documented claims. That is fine, but the rationale gives the 99215 figure and never the headline figure, so the two framings are inconsistent. C0043095 is cited as a high-complexity example, yet its 4 conditions are only moderate complexity. The comparison-provider rate of 0% is correct but there is no caveat about the small sample (n=3). The summary does not state the missing data: no 99215 documentation was supported and minutes are not recorded. C0043095 is also not clearly a mismatch between billed level and complexity, so it is weak as an upcoding example. Nothing in the summary frames the non-low-complexity 99215s, though the card does show that high-complexity claims exist.","problems":["Headline figure (4 of 14, 29%) is not explained or reconciled in the rationale, which uses the 3-of-3 99215 figure.","Very small documented 99215 sample (n=3) is presented as 100% vs 0% without a small-sample caveat.","C0043095 (77 y/o, 4 conditions) is cited as an example but is a complex patient, so it supports the documentation point and not the complexity-mismatch point; the example mix is not explained.","Does not flag what is missing, such as no documented 99215 supported by records, minutes never recorded, and only 7.6% of claims documented."]}
